description: This file manages reminder-related state and scheduling in the Notesnook project, including creating, deleting, and scheduling reminders with notifications and cron expressions.

classes.name: ReminderStore
classes.description: A store class managing reminders, including refresh and delete operations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the reminders list and optionally resets reminders and refreshes note store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes reminders by IDs and refreshes the store.

methods.name: resetReminders
methods.description: Stops all scheduled reminders and reschedules active reminders, setting notifications.

methods.name: scheduleReminder
methods.description: Schedules a reminder with a cron expression, handling notification display.

methods.name: reminderToCronExpression
methods.description: Converts a Reminder object into a cron expression string based on its scheduling details.
